## Source text

**Author:**

Cyrdach, Molsga

**Description:**

Robin Hood Ultimate Campaign Editor or Rhuce for short is a modding tool for Robin Hood: the Legend of Sherwood that enables any modder to edit various aspects of the game.

**Functionalities**

The spectrum of usage is vast. But the main focus of the tool is the capability of modifying the campaign scenarios of the game. The tool allows you to insert a new game mission into the existing story line, remove the base game missions or design a new nonlinear sequence of missions all together.

You can also modify the texts and overall mission appearance for it’s future players. The tool supports the game localization system so that you can edit the texts for all languages at once.

Another potential usage is the capability to edit stats of particular units and their weapons. You can also add or remove those.

Lastly, you can view the interface elements of the game and potentialy set your own new ones.

The mod is compatible with the game version 1.1 and it is very much recommended to use in junction with the marvelous [Spellforge editor](https://rhmods.com/tools/spellforge-editor/). It also supports using the [Ready2Play Launcher](https://rhmods.com/tools/ready2play-launcher/). I bow to their creators.
